Summary: Energy consumption per successful agent task varies widely, from fractions of a watt-hour to several kilowatt-hours, depending on system complexity and efficiency. Agentic AI systems require significant energy for operations, with some estimates showing a rebound effect due to cheaper inference costs. Effective energy management and accounting are crucial for sustainable agentic AI deployment.
